Date: 2026-09-02
Attendees: Audrey (K2), Marc (K2), Jamie Wu (founder), Lin Park (co-founder)
How We Met: Intro from a portfolio founder at last month's demo day

Company: Northwind Analytics
Sector: Developer tools
Stage: Series A
Ask: $6M at $28M post

Problem: Engineering teams lose a full day a week reconciling logs across
three separate observability tools that don't talk to each other.

Solution: A single pane of glass that ingests all three log formats and
normalizes them into one queryable timeline.

Traction: 12 paying customers, $340k ARR, added 4 logos last quarter.

Team: Both co-founders shipped observability tooling at Datadog for 5 years.
